bill.title: A Resolution urging the Pennsylvania Fish and Boat Commission to evaluate and approve the addition of the American Paddlefish to the Species by Watershed Approved for Open System Propagation and Introductions list.

posted_text:
💧 Environment & Climate
PA SR 409 — Pa. Senate Wants Paddlefish Added to State Waters

The Pennsylvania State Senate is asking the Fish and Boat Commission to consider adding the American Paddlefish to a list of species approved for open-system propagation and introductions. The resolution highlights that this prehistoric fish is declining in its native Mississippi River Basin and could benefit Pennsylvania’s waterways. ...
